intro: A Strangely Marked Box is a piece of cargo discovered inside the harnesses strapped to dead sea turtles along the Darkshore coastline. Its mysterious exterior bears the runic script of the serpentine naga, offering night elf scholars proof that these sea creatures did not strand themselves by accident.

p: While several giant sea turtles and sea creatures simply wash ashore along Darkshore's mist-veiled beaches, others tell a far more ominous tale. Scattered carcasses bear the splintered remnants of riding harnesses and abandoned carriages bound straight to their shells. Within the ruins of these buckled contraptions lie sealed containers covered in foreign, sinuous runes. Scavenging Greymist murlocs frequently take up residence in the hollow ribcages and broken wagons, picking at the carrion and guarding whatever remnants were left behind.
